Break Volley.name: Simple 1500 Series Vol. 54: The VolleyBall - Break Volley Plus
Break Volley.summary: Break Volley is an indoor volleyball game with cartoon graphics. The game features male and female teams and 12 national teams. The game supports up to four players at once.

Bushido Blade.name: Bushido Blade
Bushido Blade.summary: "Bushido" is the soul of Japan - an ancient honor code deeply followed by samurai warriors for centuries. Plunge into real world battles across vast 3D environments that you can run, slice and tear through. Sword matches become unbelievably real where one critical blow is the mean difference between death and victory.

Deadheat Road.name: Deadheat Road
Deadheat Road.summary: Deadheat Road is a classic racing game in which the player compete in a racing againts a computer player car. The races usually starts in the night and ends with the daylight. The game features different cars for the player to choose and different circuits (west and east ones). The cars can also be customized.

Final Fantasy.name: Final Fantasy
Final Fantasy.summary: The PlayStation version of Final Fantasy is largely based on the WonderSwan Color release. Major new features include higher resolution graphics, FMVs, an easy mode, a bestiary, an art gallery, and a new soundtrack.

Formula 1 Championship Edition.name: Formula 1: Championship Edition
Formula 1 Championship Edition.summary: An updated version of Psygnosis' first Formula 1 game. It features all tracks, drivers and cars from the 1997 season. Both an arcade mode and a realistic Grand Prix mode are available. New features are higher resolution and split-screen multiplayer.

Genghis Khan - Aoki Ookami to Shiroki Me.name: Genghis Khan: Aoki Ookami to Shiroki Mejika IV
Genghis Khan - Aoki Ookami to Shiroki Me.summary: A historical simulation game created by Koei in 1998. The fourth and final series of the Genghis Khan series, in 1999.

Kids Station - Ultraman Cosmos.name: Kids Station: Ultraman Cosmos
Kids Station - Ultraman Cosmos.summary: Kids Station: Ultraman Cosmos is based on the sixteenth television show in the Ultraman series.

Leading Jockey Highbred.name: Leading Jockey: Highbred
Leading Jockey Highbred.summary: The first PlayStation entry in the Leading Jockey series.

Mike Tyson Boxing.name: Mike Tyson Boxing
Mike Tyson Boxing.summary:
Mike Tyson Boxing is a 3D simulation based on one of the best-known fighters of the '80s and '90s. The game offers three main modes of play: "Vs." mode offers fast, arcade-style matches in which the loser walks and the winner stays on to meet the next challenger. "Showcase" mode allows up to eight players and eight CPU boxers to meet for rotating tournament action. In "World" mode, the player starts with a rookie fighter and guides his career fight after fight through the ranks of contenders until he finally faces the champ for the belt. Mike Tyson Boxing features over 90 different boxers and 16 world-class venues.

Fighters can interact with the ring environment and blood, sweat, and bruises are graphically depicted on the characters. Scoring is based on the point system used in real boxing and a special score bar helps players keep track of how they are doing in the heat of battle.

Panzer General.name: Panzer General
Panzer General.summary: You are the brightest and best of the new Axis generals in the Second World War. Your tactical skills will be tested in armored assaults, amphibious invasions, paradrops, naval engagements, and fierce aerial combat for control of the skies. Go from triumph to triumph, invading and seizing the capitals of Great Britain, the Soviet Union, and ultimately the United States of America on your way to conquering the whole world! Can you achieve a place in history?

World Stadium 3.name: World Stadium 3
World Stadium 3.summary: World Stadium baseball returns to the PlayStation.

Xena - Warrior Princess.name: Xena: Warrior Princess
Xena - Warrior Princess.summary: Die hard fans of the Warrior Princess now can now bring her along wherever they go, thanks to the release of XENA: Warrior Princess. Xena comes to the Game Boy Color with all the thrills and chills the fans of her TV show have come to expect. You take control of Xena as she does battle on land and in the water. Try to master fast-scrolling rides full of dangerous obstacles as you run, jump, climb, and swim your way through 16 pulse-pounding levels of heroic challenges. Use the Game Boy Color infrared ports to hook up with a friend who also has the game and you can unlock special hidden levels in each cartridge. This game could only be more fun if it came with your own chakram.
